summary: Steakholder Foods Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K reporting results of a Special General Meeting held September 16, 2026. Shareholders approved both proposals put forward, including an amendment and restatement of the company's articles of association. Approximately 1,308,636,000 ordinary shares, or 10.75% of issued and outstanding shares as of the record date, were present or represented by proxy. The amended articles are filed as Exhibit 99.1. This is a routine meeting-result disclosure, not a special situation.
